parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Considering the advantages and at least one disadvantage, explain which one of the three
sports stars would be the most suitable for the club to open the tournament.
You should concentrate on your chosen sports star and not refer to the other sports stars.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Considering three disadvantages and one advantage, explain which one of the three sports
stars would be the least suitable for the club to open the tournament.
You should concentrate on your chosen sports star and not refer to the other sports stars.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
State the three pieces of additional information provided which you found the least relevant
in deciding which sports star to choose.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Explain what the conversation between Antonia and Saul reveals about the relationship
between:

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Antonia and Saul.
Section B
Read the material for Section B in the insert before answering the questions in Section B.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: In your opinion, explain why Suzy Hansen picked ‘All Sewn Up’ as the title for her article.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain why it is surprising that the world’s third richest man is based in La Coruña in Galicia.
(lines 3 – 5)

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain why you think that Ortega does not give interviews and rarely allows his photograph
to be taken.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: According to paragraphs 7 and 8, describe how Zara’s business model differs ‘from the norm’.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
State the two reasons given as to why Inditex can accommodate more expensive workers’
pay rates.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
Explain how ‘Inditex has completely changed consumer behaviour’, according to Masoud
Golsorkhi.

parts.label: (g)
parts.text:
State the meaning of the two following words or phrases as they are used in the material.
You may write the answer in one word or a short phrase.

parts.label: (h)
parts.text:
Use the original words or phrases in 2(g) in two separate sentences to illustrate their meanings
as used in the material.
Your sentences should not deal with the subject matter of the material.
